purpose: Commits the audited input that previously lived only in an out-of-tree scratchpad file. tests/unit/i18n/test_audit_input_manifests.py recomputes every entry from the shipped catalogue.
hash_rule: sha256 of the UTF-8 bytes of the JSON-decoded value string, unnormalised
manifest_sha256_rule: sha256 of the canonical JSON of every other field (sorted keys, separators (",", ":"), ensure_ascii=False, UTF-8)
state_bound: the final audited state: round-2 values for keys remade by remediation (see remade_by_remediation), round-1 values otherwise; each shipped value equals the scratchpad patch file each record previously hashed
